title: 1811 Prairie's bay turns its canted north face, from its 1888 plate
items: 1811 Prairie's bay no longer stands square on its north side: that face now cants back to the wall, as the 1911 insurance map draws it and the 1888 plate shows it, with one narrow window a storey. The cornice, string courses and stone balustrade turn the corner with it, and the front's north window moves onto the plate's.
